name: r3a1-sources-denial-admitted-and-audited
description: Transport denial and delegation probe for knowvault_sources and its REST twin. A denied source service must yield no inventory, confirmation context or workspace-id echo. Weakening the ListSources error guard lets the denied call fall through to success; dropping typed denial recognition maps it to service unavailable. Both mutants compile and are killed by TestMCPKnowvaultSourcesDenialAdmittedAndAudited. Its fake admission/denial strings establish delegation only, not durable audit. Production admission and terminal persistence, including failed appends and cancellation, are separately proved by tests/integration/postgres/source_metadata_audit_test.go through the real repository and PostgreSQL journal.

baseline_meaning: The injected source service denies access. MCP returns -32004 source scope not found without a result; REST returns 404 NOT_FOUND without content. The fake records delegation order only. The production source.metadata.read.admitted/completed/failed events and closed SOURCE_METADATA_READ_DENIED failure code are covered by the separate real-PostgreSQL source metadata tests, not by this mutation probe.
mutant_meaning: With the ListSources denial guard weakened to `if err == nil` a denied/foreign call skips the refusal and falls through to the success projection, which carries an empty `sources` list, the confirmation context and `isError: false` instead of the existing -32004 content-free denial; with the typed denial recognition dropped the same workspacerepository CodeDenied/CodeNotFound maps to the generic -32000 service-unavailable instead of -32004. Both mutated files still read `err` and keep the -32004 branch referenced, so internal/platform/workspaceapi compiles and the failure is the behavioural TestMCPKnowvaultSourcesDenialAdmittedAndAudited assertion (a denied `knowvault_sources` call must return the existing denial and no content), not a build failure; each mutant is killed by the registered probe and not vacuous.
runner: tests/contracts/mutation-runner/main.go executes these cases from tests/contracts/mutation-registry.json under the GO_UNIT harness for the invariant entry `acceptance.r3a1.sources.denial-admitted-and-audited`; the identical cases are committed both here and in the registry so the proof is pinned to the product guard.
